items.title: RIKEN AIP researchers have 9 main-conference papers accepted to EMNLP 2026
items.summary_en: RIKEN AIP announced that papers involving its researchers were accepted to EMNLP 2026. According to the search snippet, these are nine papers in the Main Conference, seven in Findings, and two in other tracks or co-located events.
items.notes: aip.riken.jp still blocked; title, date and counts from a search snippet only. Acceptance announcement; paper titles not reviewed.
